info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Delinquent Account Handling API
info.description: The Delinquent Account Handling API provides essential services for managing accounts that are considered delinquent. This API enables financial institutions to retrieve critical information regarding delinquent accounts, including their status, outstanding balances, and customer details. Typical consumers include collections teams, compliance officers, and financial analysts who require up-to-date insights to mitigate risks and enhance recovery efforts. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their account management processes and improve overall financial health.

get.summary: Retrieve delinquent account handling details for a specific account.
get.description: Fetch the details related to the handling of a delinquent account identified by ACC-200045. This endpoint provides comprehensive information on the actions taken and the current status of the account.
